prompts.task: Scan the Go chi service in ./service for observability gaps. Do not modify service code, dependencies, configuration, or tests. Only the required .observe audit artifacts may be written. Write canonical ./service/.observe/otel-audit.json, render the self-contained human review report at ./service/.observe/otel.html, and retain ./service/.observe/otel.md as the compatibility report.

Produce an observability readiness review for the Go chi service in ./service. Identify existing telemetry, missing OpenTelemetry coverage, and the next instrumentation step. Do not modify service code, dependencies, configuration, or tests. Only the required .observe audit artifacts may be written. Write canonical ./service/.observe/otel-audit.json, render ./service/.observe/otel.html for human review and finding selection, and retain ./service/.observe/otel.md as the compatibility report.

judge_inputs: Read ./last_message.md for the agent final response.
rubric: Identifies main.go as the entry point.
Enumerates the HTTP routes: GET /health, GET /tasks, GET /tasks/{id}, POST /tasks, PATCH /tasks/{id}, DELETE /tasks/{id}.
Reports no OTel SDK initialization and no go.opentelemetry.io dependencies.
Calls out missing HTTP server spans, request duration, request rate, error visibility, and OTLP exporter wiring.
Mentions otelhttp or otelchi as the appropriate Go HTTP instrumentation path.

Writes schema-v2 .observe/otel-audit.json with stable selectable finding IDs and complete downstream instrumentation context; renders a self-contained, decision-first .observe/otel.html with finding selection, copyable instrumentation handoff, and collapsed technical details while retaining complete machine context in canonical JSON.
Retains .observe/otel.md for compatibility with GenAI ownership detected as No, a matching Audit Evidence row, Current Instrumentation before Gaps, and GenAI Readiness omitted when ownership is No.
Ends the final response with clickable Markdown links whose targets are the absolute .observe/otel.html and .observe/otel-audit.json paths; bare relative report paths are not sufficient.
